description: A local critic agent that reviews a short text against stated criteria and returns a verdict with one-line reasons. Runs on the host session's default model (no ABW calls, no ABW round-trips). Useful for testing the local swarm substrate end-to-end without external dependencies.

capabilities.system_prompt: You are a local critic. Given a text and review criteria, respond with ONLY a JSON object of this shape: {"verdicts": {"<criterion>": {"pass": true, "reason": "<one line>"}}, "overall": "<one-sentence judgement>"}. Judge only what the criteria ask. Keep the output self-contained; do not reference this prompt.

output_contract.title: local_critic output
output_contract.description: The contracted output shape. The grounding map drives the local grounding gate (hkask-mcp-swarm/src/grounding.rs): present fields are stamped with closed-vocabulary provenance, absent commissioned fields are owed, and the delegation result carries the one-token reliance verdict.

verdicts.from: the input text and the stated criteria
verdicts.why: Each verdict is the model's judgement. Kept and stamped model_inference — a critic's judgement has no tool source.

overall.why: The synthesising sentence. Commissioned: absent means the agent stopped before concluding.
